why: Training centres (language, technical, academic) need cohort management, attendance tracking, fee collection and teacher payout sharing. Distinct from school: adult learners, no child data, focus on course completion and payouts.
operator: The training centre manager oversees cohorts of adult learners, attendance, fee collection and teacher commissions. Their day is attendance checks, fee reminders and commission calculations per teacher per cohort.
entities: TrainingCenter (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Cohort (id, centerId, nameAr, nameEn, startDate, endDate, subject, capacity, enrolledCount, status)
Attendance (id, cohortId, learnerId, date, status (present/absent/late), notes)
Learner (id, centerId, name, phone, email, totalSessions, attendedSessions, feePiasters, status)
Teacher (id, centerId, name, phone, commissionRatePiasters, status, assignedCohortId)
FeeRecord (id, learnerId, amountPiasters, dueDate, paidAt, status)
Payout (id, teacherId, amountPiasters, cohortId, period, status, paidAt)
batches: No : training centre carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Sessions and cohorts have date ranges not expiry dates
special: The core structures are the cohort with enrolled learners, the attendance tracker per session, the fee record per learner and the teacher payout per cohort. No child data is collected (adult learners only).
screens: Cohort list: all cohorts with name, subject, start/end dates, enrolled count, capacity, status
Cohort detail: enrolled learners, attendance per session, fee status per learner, assigned teacher
Attendance taking: select cohort, mark present/absent/late for each learner, save attendance for the session
Learner profile: total sessions, attended sessions, fee status, outstanding balance, payment history
Fee record: enter amount, due date, mark paid, record receipt, compute outstanding per learner
Teacher payout: select cohort, compute commission per teacher based on attended sessions, generate payout doc
Staff shift: clock in/out, cohort load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : cohorts, learners, fees, payouts, reports, billing
Manager: cohorts, learners, fees, payout approval
Instructor: mark attendance per session, view learner fee status
Administrator: fee records, payout generation, cohort management
reports: Cohort attendance rate: present vs absent vs late per cohort per period
Learner completion rate: sessions attended vs total per learner per cohort
Fee collection rate: collected vs outstanding per period, aging of outstanding
Teacher payout summary: total per teacher per period, commission computation verification
Revenue per cohort: total fees collected vs total feasible per cohort per period
integrations: WhatsApp deep link for attendance alerts and fee reminders to learners
Email for fee invoices and payout summaries (opt-in)
Paymob or Fawry for fee collection (optional)
CSV import for bulk learner enrollment
onboarding: Center basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial cohorts: the subject areas, start/end dates, capacity per cohort
Fee structure: the fee per session or per cohort, payment terms
Teachers: add the initial team with their commission rates and assigned cohorts
First week plan: create first cohort, enroll first learners, first attendance session
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the cohort/learner/fee/payout schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add cohort list and detail screen
tasks.brief: Build the cohort screen: list all cohorts with name, subject, dates, enrolled count, capacity, status. Done when the cohort list loads and the detail screen shows enrolled learners and fee status.
tasks.done: When cohort list and detail screen works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add attendance taking screen
tasks.brief: Build the attendance screen: select cohort, mark present/absent/late for each learner, save attendance for the session. Done when attendance is saved and propagates to learner profile.
tasks.done: When attendance taking works end-to-end and updates learner data

tasks.title: Add learner profile with fee status
tasks.brief: Build the learner profile: total sessions, attended sessions, fee status, outstanding balance, payment history. Done when the profile saves and displays correct data.
tasks.done: When learner profile works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add fee record screen with due date and payment
tasks.brief: Build the fee record screen: enter amount, due date, mark paid, record receipt, compute outstanding. Done when the fee record saves and the outstanding balance updates correctly.
tasks.done: When fee record screen works end-to-end with balance computation

tasks.title: Add teacher payout computation screen
tasks.brief: Build the payout screen: select cohort, compute commission per teacher based on attended sessions, generate payout doc. Done when the payout computes correctly and the doc is saved to Firestore.
tasks.done: When teacher payout computation works end-to-end and saves doc

tasks.title: Add cohort attendance rate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing present vs absent vs late per cohort per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct rates.
tasks.done: When attendance rate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add learner completion rate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing sessions attended vs total per learner per cohort. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct rates.
tasks.done: When completion rate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add fee collection rate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing collected vs outstanding per period, aging of outstanding. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When fee collection rate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add teacher payout summary report
tasks.brief: Build the summary showing total payout per teacher per period and commission verification. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When payout summary report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial training center setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: center basics, initial cohorts, fee structure, teachers addition. Done when the flow completes and the center appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and center is created

risks: No child data collected (adult learners only), but encryption still required for all personal data per PDPL
Encryption key loss makes all records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Fee collection without clear due dates and outstanding caps can violate consumer protection law
